project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 3 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 7 of 10 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Jackfield qualifies as a local detour through Jackfield Tile Museum and Jackfield Landslip (1952). It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Jackfield: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Jackfield offers Jackfield Tile Museum, Jackfield Landslip (1952), CHURCH OF ST MARY THE VIRGIN within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Jackfield Tile Museum
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Jackfield Tile Museum and Jackfield Landslip (1952), then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.

dontMiss: CHURCH OF ST MARY THE VIRGIN
